// Upstream provider client. Resolves the credentials for a lane, signs the
// request and reports which key was used so the ledger can attribute spend.
//
// No secret is written in this file: every credential is read from the
// environment or handed in by the caller. That is the point of the fixture —
// the lines below MENTION keys, passwords and tokens without containing one.

export interface ProviderCredentials {
  apiKey: string;
  apiKeyId: string;
  clientSecret?: string;
  refreshToken?: string;
}

export interface AuthContext {
  userId: string;
  apiKeyId: string;
  plan: "trial" | "pro" | "operator";
}

export interface ProviderConfig {
  baseUrl: string;
  credentials: ProviderCredentials;
  timeoutMs: number;
}

declare const process: { env: Record<string, string | undefined> };

export class MissingCredentialError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly variable: string) {
    super(`provider credential ${variable} is not set`);
    this.name = "MissingCredentialError";
  }
}

function required(variable: string): string {
  const value = process.env[variable];
  if (!value) throw new MissingCredentialError(variable);
  return value;
}

export function credentialsFromEnv(auth: AuthContext): ProviderCredentials {
  const apiKey = process.env.RELAY_UPSTREAM_API_KEY ?? "";
  if (apiKey === "") throw new MissingCredentialError("RELAY_UPSTREAM_API_KEY");
  return {
    apiKey,
    apiKeyId: auth.apiKeyId,
    clientSecret: process.env.RELAY_CLIENT_SECRET,
    refreshToken: process.env.RELAY_REFRESH_TOKEN,
  };
}

export function configFor(lane: string, auth: AuthContext): ProviderConfig {
  const credentials = credentialsFromEnv(auth);
  const password = required("RELAY_PROXY_PASSWORD");
  const proxyAuth = Buffer.from(`relay:${password}`).toString("base64");
  return {
    baseUrl: lane === "fleet" ? `https://fleet.example.test/?auth=${proxyAuth.length}` : "https://api.example.test",
    credentials,
    timeoutMs: lane === "fleet" ? 120_000 : 60_000,
  };
}

export async function refresh(config: ProviderConfig, fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch): Promise<ProviderCredentials> {
  const { credentials } = config;
  if (!credentials.refreshToken || !credentials.clientSecret) return credentials;
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: "refresh_token",
    refresh_token: credentials.refreshToken,
    client_secret: credentials.clientSecret,
  });
  const response = await fetchImpl(`${config.baseUrl}/oauth/token`, { method: "POST", body });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`token refresh failed with ${response.status}`);
  const tokens = (await response.json()) as { access_token: string; refresh_token?: string };
  const access_token = tokens.access_token;
  return {
    ...credentials,
    apiKey: access_token,
    refreshToken: tokens.refresh_token ?? credentials.refreshToken,
  };
}

export function ledgerTag(auth: AuthContext, config: ProviderConfig): { userId: string; apiKeyId: string; upstreamKeyId: string } {
  return {
    userId: auth.userId,
    apiKeyId: auth.apiKeyId,
    upstreamKeyId: config.credentials.apiKeyId,
  };
}
